name: opencode-dev-process
description: OpenCode plugin: start dev servers as detached background processes (no agent-shell blocking) and monitor them live in the right sidebar.

scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:tui
scripts.build:tui: bun build ./src/tui/index.tsx --target bun --outdir dist/tui --format esm --jsx-import-source @opentui/solid --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opcode-ai/plugin --external solid-js --external @opentui/solid --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/keymap
